Proposition
[Space of homogeneous (harmonic) polynomials (Proposition K.19)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0368, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0369 1. appk:K.19\group Sphere Spectrum

For $\mathcal P_k$ the degree-$k$ homogeneous polynomials and $\mathcal H_k$ the harmonic ones, \[ \mathcal P_{k+2}=\mathcal H_{k+2}\oplus r^2\mathcal P_k. \] Consequently $\mathcal P_{2j}$ and $\mathcal P_{2j+1}$ decompose orthogonally into the corresponding sums of $r^{2\ell }\mathcal H_{k-2\ell }$, and the restrictions of the $\mathcal H_k$ form a complete orthogonal system on $S^n$.
